J1.evidence: Arabic ﴿عَلَى﴾ عَنْ glosses عَلَى as meaning عَنْ ('from/about'); English '(meaning: to)' gives a wrong sense and hides the gloss; should say it means «عَنْ» (from), as Turkish '«عَنْ» mânâsında'.

J2.evidence: Arabic ﴿عَلَى﴾ عَنْ glosses على as عَنْ ('from/away from': not incapable of / not outrun from replacing you). English '(meaning: to)' gives a different preposition and loses the gloss word; the Turkish correctly has «عَنْ» mânâsında and 'kılmaktan ... yaratmaktan'. Fix: '(in the sense of «عَنْ», from)' with the following verbs rendered accordingly.

en.fixed_note: Gloss of عَلَى corrected from '(meaning: to)' to 'in the sense of «عَنْ» (from)' as in the Arabic
en.verify_note: على now glossed as «عَنْ» (from) per source; نجعل, مكانكم, نخلقكم, من الصور كالقردة والخنازير all rendered.
